PANEL 5 BOTTOM LEFT: back to foreground-left public counter, same sides as panels 1 and 2. Renata folds a location slip, steward provides a request receipt, the current and earlier folders remain on the wood. No automatic change to displayed findings.

The child's yellow paper sun now has the small folded receipt clipped on like a jaunty hat. Renata holds it gently and smiles, with a glimpse of the river and inherited Toledo-like buildings through the window. A quiet human ending, question unfinished and something usable in hand.
Caption box EXACT: "Not an answer yet. Something she can come back for."

ONLY the exact quoted text above and title, with no invented text. Maintain six panels, coherent faces/costumes, visible closed cooler, protected ground trolley, and small yellow paper sun. The environment supports the encounter, not a technical explanatory sheet.
